html:
Not every input is a grid of pixels or a left-to-right sequence. This short section covers architectures built for data with a different shape: networks of relationships, continuous-time processes, and models that grow a team of specialists instead of one block.

Topics in this section:

  • Graph Neural Networks: learning from data that is a network of related items.
  • Neural ODEs: treating a network's depth as continuous time instead of discrete layers.
  • Mixture of Experts: routing each input to a handful of specialist sub-networks instead of running the whole model.
